title: Describe the components of comprehensive income and prepare a statement of comprehensive income and a statement of stockholders’ equity.

items.concept: Components of comprehensive income — initial AFS recognition; multi-period subsequent measurement (AOCI / FV-adjustment schedule); period-end OCI and closing JEs; disposal of AFS with reclassification; statements of comprehensive income and stockholders’ equity

Number-variant twin — separate statement of comprehensive income; columnar statement of stockholders’ equity; AOCI subsequent measurement; period-end OCI (AFS + cash-flow hedge) and equity closing JEs; common stock issuance
Period-end comprehensive income reporting when AOCI begins with a debit (accumulated loss) balance; SCI preparation; AOCI and RE rollforwards; closing JEs
Classification — whether items enter comprehensive income as NI or OCI, and whether they accumulate in RE or AOCI; compute ending AOCI and comprehensive income
